entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Lock the Frame

*The joints grind shut and the body becomes a single weight planted against the shove.*

Before this creature is forcibly moved while on solid ground, gain Stability 3 for that forced movement only. Use the highest source. In a collision chain, declare before its Stability is deducted; prior collision damage still resolves. This does not resist Prone or grapples.

details.flavorMarkdown: *A civic statue has climbed down from its pedestal, leaving a clean pair of footprints in old soot.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Ceremonial spear

**Target:** One visible creature within 2 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Push 3. **Standard defense:** Push 1.

**Limit:** Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules to the printed distance.

### Become Still

*Its body settles into the posture of a piece of the surrounding stonework.*

Gain 1 additional Bane against the next player attack before its next turn, or 1 defense Boon when player-controlled. Ends if it voluntarily moves. Does not make it Hidden, alter its resistance or stack with itself.

### Lock the Frame

*The joints grind shut and the body becomes a single weight planted against the shove.*

Before this creature is forcibly moved while on solid ground, gain Stability 3 for that forced movement only. Use the highest source. In a collision chain, declare before its Stability is deducted; prior collision damage still resolves. This does not resist Prone or grapples.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Lifeless Body — Passive:** Does not breathe or eat; only its listed immunities apply.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Construct: ordinary living-target healing does not repair it; a repair ability must explicitly permit constructs.

**Senses:** Dark sight 6 squares; ordinary hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Repeat the civic duty literally, using reach and stillness to guard its chosen boundary. A repaired inscription may offer a better answer than force.

**Encounter and conversation:** It is trying to perform a public duty described by an inscription that has lost several crucial words.

**Habitat:** Workshop; old civic building; sealed vault · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Construct 3 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/animated-statue.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-animated-statue


**Category:** Construct · **Role:** Displacer · **CV:** 22

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 3/5/7

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.35

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.3 → 1.35: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.05. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.000, O=4.000. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [Lock the Frame](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/lock-the-frame.md), [stone still](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/stone-still.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.

# Driving Blow

*The blow lands with enough force to send its victim stumbling backward.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-driving-blow


**Action:** Main Action

Use the printed attack. Standard pushes the target 1 square; Strong pushes it 2. Apply Stability before moving. This is a rider, not a separate attack or Force action.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

[Creature procedure](../bestiary/procedure.md) · [Monster ability index](README.md)

monsterAbilityTemplates.name: Lifeless Body
monsterAbilityTemplates.flavorMarkdown: *Nothing breathes beneath the torn coat; nothing living looks through the visor.*
monsterAbilityTemplates.rulesMarkdown:
The card must list its exact condition immunities; this trait grants no additional unlisted ones. It does not breathe or need food. Undead entries marked healing-harmed take a healing result as Life damage; constructs marked repair-only do not regain HP from ordinary healing. Neither rule prevents physical attacks from dealing their normal minimum damage.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
